meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 这个技能会调试并修复 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的软件缺陷。它在临时工作区复现问题、写回归测试、做最小修复，然后按规则交付：上游 Codex 的 bug 提交 fork PR，LazyCodex 自己的 bug 提交带补丁的 issue，并附带复现/验证日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、贡献 bug 修复、为 bug 开 PR 等涉及 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复 LazyCodex 里的这个崩溃 bug。
say.note: Claude 会开始调试并提交修复。

say.text: 为这个 Codex CLI 缺陷提交一个修复 PR。
say.note: 会走 openai/codex 的 fork PR 流程。

say.text: 给 lazycodex 的这个问题开个带补丁的 issue。
say.note: 会创建 verified-fix issue，不会开 PR。

howto.what_en: Debug and fix LazyCodex/Codex bugs in a temp workspace: reproduce, add failing test, minimal fix. Delivers a fork PR for openai/codex or a verified-fix issue with patch for the lazycodex repo, plus repro/verification logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix/debug a LazyCodex/Codex bug, contribute a bug fix, or open a PR for a defect.

say_en.text: Help me fix this crash bug in LazyCodex.
say_en.note: Claude will debug and submit the fix.

say_en.text: Submit a fix PR for this Codex CLI defect.
say_en.note: Goes through the upstream openai/codex fork PR flow.

say_en.text: Open a patch-embedded issue for this lazycodex bug.
say_en.note: Creates a verified-fix issue, never a PR.
